sources.title: text-image-retrieval · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: A PyTorch framework for learning aligned image-text representations using frozen pretrained vision and language encoders with trainable adaptors. Inspired by Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training (SigLIP), the project provides configurable training, retrieval, and data-processing tools for multimodal representation learning.

sources.title: Text To Image retrieval | AI Research Papers
sources.snippet: Text-to-image retrieval focuses on developing AI models that can accurately find images matching a textual description. Instead of relying solely on image metadata tags, these systems learn to understand the semantic relationship between text and visual content.
